summary: Two bedroom groundfloor flat · Available now · Great South Shields location · Close to sea front
description:
My Property Box welcome to the Lettings market this two double bedroom ground floor flat on St. Vincent Street, NE33. Situated in the popular South Shields suburb, the well presented flat offers; two bedrooms, central living room, kitchen & family bathroom. Close proximity to the sea front as well as local amenities and transport links. The property benefits from UPVC double glazing, gas central heating and street parking. There is also a private yard to the rear.

Available now. Unfurnished. This property will be in high demand so contact MPB today to arrange a viewing.
